record.paper: An update on reconfiguring $10$-colorings of planar graphs

dossier_meta.paper: An update on reconfiguring $10$-colorings of planar graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: What is the minimum integer $\kappa$ such that for every planar graph $G$ with $n$ vertices, $R_{\kappa}(G)$ has diameter $O(n)$?
dossier_meta.context_text: Planar graphs are 5-degenerate and have maximum average degree less than 6; prior results give $R_8(G)$ diameter $O(n(\log n)^7)$ and $R_{12}(G)$ diameter at most $6n$ for planar $G$. The paper improves the upper bound to $\kappa \leq 10$ via Theorem 4, and an isolated 6-coloring of the icosahedron shows $\kappa \geq 7$; the authors note that $\kappa = 7$ cannot be excluded.
